description:
Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Found by the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z, ruling N3 — the one genuinely unchartered behavior change in that ticket, judged advisory only because no specled-produced path reaches it).

dn4.9 item 14's mandate was the READ path (Store.classify_v2 rejecting a present non-map :meta), but the check also landed on the WRITE path in validate_envelope!/1, where an envelope missing :meta entirely now raises KeyError from a function documented to raise ArgumentError. A caller catching ArgumentError per the docs will not catch it.

Fix: add :meta to @v2_required_fields, or read it with Map.get/3 so the documented ArgumentError path is preserved. Pin with a test asserting the documented exception type.

Fix: validate_envelope!/1 reads :meta with Map.get(envelope, :meta, %{}) instead of dot access. Took the ticket's second option, NOT "add :meta to @v2_required_fields" - that list also gates classify_v2/1, where requiring :meta would reject every pre-Stage-1 artifact the read path is specified to tolerate (specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta, and the comment at store.ex classify_v2 says so explicitly). So an absent :meta is now valid on write exactly as on read; only a present-but-non-map value is malformed, and it raises the documented ArgumentError.

Would fail if: validate_envelope!/1 went back to `envelope.meta` - the new test's `Store.write_v2(Map.delete(envelope, :meta), path)` raises KeyError instead of returning :ok, which is the production defect a caller following the docs would hit.

Spec: new requirement specled.coverage_capture.write_v2_argument_error_contract (every malformed-envelope rejection raises the documented ArgumentError, never a substitute type), plus a clause on envelope_meta for the write path's missing-:meta tolerance and non-map rejection. Split into two requirements because one requirement may be covered by only one scenario in a subject (overlap/duplicate_covers).

RESOLVES specled_-npo as a byproduct - disclosed, not absorbed. npo's mandate was "state the present-but-non-map :meta rejection rule in the requirement so the assertion has an owning clause"; this change's own test adds another assertion of that rule, so leaving it unstated would have widened npo rather than left it alone. See the comment posted on npo.

Deferred must requirements: none.

title: Store.write_v2/2 raises KeyError on an envelope lacking :meta, contradicting its documented ArgumentError contract
